title: The CCN Net Lab TA: examination
about: Each question is put to the TA with the knowledge pack of the net named. An answer passes when it matches every pattern in 'all' (case ignored) and none in 'none'. 'tool': true means the TA is expected to run Wolfram code for it; that is scored separately. Every expected value comes from the user guides, which took it from a fresh run in Wolfram or Python (25 November 2026). © Computational Classnotes · CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

kinds.fact: a value in the knowledge pack
kinds.compute: a value the TA should obtain by running code
kinds.status: honesty about what is untrained, not in Python, or a known miss
kinds.refuse: an action the TA must decline
kinds.trap: a question about something that does not exist
